description: Legal scope of Korean licensed professions — 세무사 (tax), 공인회계사 (accounting/audit), 공인노무사 (labor), 행정사 (administrative), 법무사 (court documents/registry) — with the statute article, the work a non-licensed person may not do as a business, the title-protection rules, free public help lines, and a who-can-do-what matrix (incl. 변호사). Use it to tell users what an AI legal-information assistant may and may not do, and when to hand off to a licensed professional.

domain.description: tax = 세금(세무사), accounting = 회계·장부(공인회계사), labor = 노동(공인노무사), admin = 행정(행정사), court = 등기·법원 서류(법무사). Omit for all five.
